papers.text: Build Kitecombe a hill. The League currently launches from a chair.
papers.subject: kites

papers.text: Fund a new reel of string for the League. 61 % of the old reel is in hedges.
papers.subject: kites

papers.text: Plant a topiary kite on the Kitecombe field. Then a topiary string. Then a topiary flyer.
papers.subject: hedges

papers.text: Declare the Kitecombe hedge maze free of kites. Those inside must apply in writing to leave.
papers.subject: hedges

papers.text: A sign over the Fogmoor water, facing the sky: KITES, PLEASE GO ROUND.
papers.subject: signage

papers.text: Fund new shears for the Committee. The Muchpuddle willow has been told to expect them.
papers.subject: hedges

papers.text: The League would like a level playing field. The band has one, at Brassby, for concerts.
papers.subject: kites

papers.text: Roof the spotters' bench at Fogmoor. Of last year's sightings, 30 % were kites.
papers.subject: buses

papers.text: Pose beside a hedge clipped in your likeness. A modest hedge.
papers.subject: hedges

papers.text: Let the Guild decorate the Brassby hedges. The Committee says they are already dressed.
papers.subject: hedges

papers.text: The Circle offers a fee for the band to practise indoors. Any indoors. Far indoors.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: Fit awnings to the Middlingham windows, printed: THIS IS NOT A LANDING.
papers.subject: signage

papers.text: A net over the Brassby marrow beds. Last year a kite came second in the marrows.
papers.subject: vegetable-shows

papers.text: Judge the hedge show, President. All 212 entries are straight; choose the straightest.
papers.subject: hedges

papers.text: An inquiry into why coaches come in threes. Evidence in triplicate, in the Guild's window.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The inquiry has seen three more coaches. It asks for three more windows.

papers.text: Ride the first coach of the season, President. The spotters will log you as luggage.
papers.subject: buses

papers.text: Hold the Muchpuddle marrow show in the coach park. Coaches left there will be weighed.
papers.subject: vegetable-shows

papers.text: A committee to choose the band's next tune. It will audition every tune, on the kite field.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The tune committee has heard every tune. It asks to hear them all again, in order.

papers.text: A sound shell for the Brassby band. It faces the water, for the acoustics.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: Every hedge to carry a sign: KITES MAY LAND HERE. The hedges were not asked.
papers.subject: signage

papers.text: The band will buy a licence to echo across Muchpuddle water. Each tune arrives twice.
papers.subject: paperwork

papers.text: Lend the Guild the founding napkin for a window. They promise to iron it first.
papers.subject: paperwork

papers.text: A study to measure the silence by Fogmoor water. Early results: 70 % quiet, 30 % band.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The silence study needs a quieter room to write up in. It asks for the band's.

papers.text: The spotters will pay to stand in the Teacup Downs marrow beds. Then to sit. Then to picnic.
papers.subject: buses

papers.text: A working group to tie up loose ends: every kite string in a hedge. It may take a while.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The loose-ends group has tied itself to a hedge. It asks for a second group to untie it.

papers.text: Be photographed waving from every coach in the Republic. One a day. Rodney has the list.
papers.subject: vanity

papers.text: Swap the band's Sunday concert for the Circle's Sunday quiet. Same hour, fewer notes.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: A travelling hat, just for you. And one for your coach. And one for each wheel, perhaps?
papers.subject: hats

favour.text: About the hat: it would like the spotters to log it as a coach. It keeps good time.

clippings.sign: SPOTTERS TOLD TO LOG A HAT; HAT RUNS LATE
clippings.refuse: HAT IS NOT A COACH, PRESIDENT RULES

papers.text: The Guild will pay for quiet on display day. The band rattles eleven panes a tune.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: Rodney has clipped your signature into a hedge. He proposes the other four thousand.
papers.subject: vanity

papers.text: Rename the Fogmoor riverbank BANDSTAND (TEMPORARY) on Thursdays. The fish will be told.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: Survey every hedge edge in the Republic with a ruler. Kites will be asked to stand still.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The hedge survey has found that the ruler is not straight. It asks to survey the ruler.

papers.text: The growers will hire the Kitecombe field for a show. Any kite landing will be judged.
papers.subject: vegetable-shows

papers.text: Lend the spotters the Middlingham shop windows. Coaches look better through polished glass.
papers.subject: buses

papers.text: Pose beside the prize marrow for its portrait, President. Slightly behind it, please.
papers.subject: vegetable-shows

papers.text: The League will pay a fee for every kite fetched out of a hedge. The hedges have kept 41.
papers.subject: kites

papers.text: A fruit basket, as before. It has a ribbon on it, as before. No reason, as before.
papers.subject: ribbons

favour.text: About the basket: it would like a shop window to itself. The Guild's best, in Middlingham.

clippings.sign: PRESIDENT'S BASKET TAKES GUILD'S BEST WINDOW
clippings.refuse: BASKET REFUSED A WINDOW; TO BE EATEN INSTEAD

papers.text: A working group on what counts as a marrow. It meets in the beds where the spotters stand.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The marrow group has found three marrows that may be courgettes. It asks for a sub-group.

papers.text: A desk fountain, just for you. It tinkles. The next one up gushes. Just so you know.
papers.subject: fountains

favour.text: About the desk fountain: it is lonely. It asks to be put beside the anglers' water.

clippings.sign: DESK FOUNTAIN MOVES TO RIVERBANK; ANGLERS HEAR TINKLING
clippings.refuse: FOUNTAIN STAYS ON DESK, TINKLING AT NOBODY

papers.text: The Committee will pay for a permit to clip the coach stop hedge. Spotters to lean by permit.
papers.subject: hedges
